name: semantic-retrieval-feature-study-v1
target_boundary: Exclude the query policy from every labeled retrieval bank. Training features leave one entire policy out and additionally purge reference body/support matches to those query bodies. Outer validation uses only the purged outer-training bank, excludes a matching query policy, and never accepts a target column. No target label is reassigned across policies.
scope: One additional target-derived feature family on the same seven expanded splits. Five fixed fits per split; no new encoder, label source, model tuning or confirmation access.
